metadata.description: General-purpose agent skills, packaged by theme: hardware-lab (USB analysis and bench instruments), agent-workflow (session learning, handoffs, loop safety, design partnership), dev-tools (Jujutsu, dependency scoring, CLI conventions). The everything plugin bundles all three.

plugins.name: hardware-lab
plugins.description: Bench and USB-analysis skills: Cynthion setup, capture, pcap decode and protocol reverse-engineering, USB device profiles, the MCCI 3411 test device, Bus Pirate, Siglent oscilloscope control, OWON electronic load queries, and FNIRSI DPS-150 supply control.

plugins.name: agent-workflow
plugins.description: Working with a coding agent over time: session learning and teaching summaries, handoffs, transcript access, loop safety (intern-mode), design partnership, harness-agnostic skill authoring, and Google Docs review rounds.

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Engineering utilities: Jujutsu (jj) in place of git, evidence-based dependency scoring (dep-quality), conventions for CLIs that agents drive (cli-conventions), a seven-arm adversarial code review with a referee (review-swarm), and a release train that installs and smoke-tests every distribution channel before tagging (release-train).

plugins.name: everything
plugins.description: Every skill in this repository in one plugin: hardware-lab, agent-workflow and dev-tools combined. Install either this or the themed plugins, not both.
